Hotel Policies

Terms & Conditions

Tariff inclusions, check-out settlement rules, and general stay terms at T.M. Hotel, Madurai.

1

Tariff & GST Inclusions

Published tariffs are inclusive of GST. Meals, laundry, airport transfers, and other auxiliary services are available and charged separately upon consumption.

2

Bill Settlement

All room and incidental bills must be settled in full upon check-out using cash, debit/credit card payments, or approved online digital transfers. Personal cheques are not accepted for online travel agency (OTA) bookings.

3

Check-In & Valid Identity

Standard check-in is 12:00 PM (Noon) and check-out is 11:00 AM. Guests must present valid government-issued photo identity and address proof (PAN Card is not accepted as valid ID).

4

Management Lien

In the event of a default in payment of hotel dues, management retains a lien on the guest’s luggage and belongings with the right to detain or sell them to clear outstanding dues.
